relationships.subject: dorsal horn c-MafEX neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Transient activation of c-MafEX neurons led to a strong reduction in mechanical thresholds in the von Frey test

relationships.subject: dorsal horn c-MafEX neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: activation of c-MafEX neurons also led to profound spontaneous aversive behaviors, including biting and flinching of the ipsilateral hindpaw

relationships.subject: dorsal horn c-MafIN neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of c-MafIN neurons (Figures S6G–S6K) conversely reduced responses to noxious mechanical and dynamic mechanical stimuli

relationships.subject: dorsal horn c-MafIN neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: c-Maf<sup>EX</sup> neurons also receive input from inhibitory c-Maf and parvalbumin neurons, and compromising inhibition by these neurons caused mechanical hypersensitivity and spontaneous aversive behaviors reminiscent of c-Maf<sup>EX</sup> neuron activation.

relationships.subject: dorsal horn parvalbumin neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: c-Maf<sup>EX</sup> neurons also receive input from inhibitory c-Maf and parvalbumin neurons, and compromising inhibition by these neurons caused mechanical hypersensitivity and spontaneous aversive behaviors reminiscent of c-Maf<sup>EX</sup> neuron activation.

relationships.subject: myelinated sensory afferents
relationships.evidence_quote: We find that excitatory c-Maf (c-Maf<sup>EX</sup>) neurons receive sensory input mainly from myelinated fibers and target deep dorsal horn parabrachial projection neurons and superficial dorsal horn neurons

relationships.subject: dorsal horn c-MafEX neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that 88.4% ± 2.2% of all excitatory c-Maf neurons (c-Maf+; Pax2−) co-expressed GFP

key_findings: Excitatory c-Maf neurons in deep dorsal horn laminae III-IV receive mainly myelinated LTMR input and are a CCK subpopulation; silencing them alleviates mechanical hypersensitivity in neuropathic but not naive mice.
Chemogenetic activation of c-MafEX neurons causes mechanical hypersensitivity and spontaneous aversive behaviors; they are gated by inhibitory c-Maf and parvalbumin neurons.
